name: Jaggln
summary: Tyrolean partnership trick-taking game for five where two players ally to win five of nine special counters.
rules_text: Jaggln uses 33 German-suited cards: A-10-K-O-U-9-8-7 in each suit plus Six of Bells. Three cards are permanent top trumps above all: Jaggl (U of Bells), Zanggl (10, also called Waxbock) and Buggl (6 of Bells). The Gewisses are the four Sows (Deuces), four Tens and the Jaggl - nine cards total. Deal 6 cards to each of 5 players or 5 to each of 6; deal 3 face-down as doaba. Dealer variation: with 7, dealer sits out. Forehand declares partner by naming a card; the trump suit is the natural suit of that card, with special mappings e.g. Jaggl=>Bells, Zanggl=>Hearts, Buggl=>Acorns. Its holder becomes declarer's partner; if it lies in the doaba declarer plays solo. Declarer may take the doaba then discard same number, but may not discard Sows or Tens. Cards are played to tricks, must follow suit if able, may trump otherwise, no need to head. Team capturing at least 5 Gewisses wins the deal; losing side without a trick pays double.
rating_reason: Five-player Tyrolean trump game, specific gewisses objective.
